mapper.select: SELECT * FROM s_user_account WHERE id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s_member_balance_lot l JOIN s_venue_customer c ON c.id = l.venue_customer_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND (l.frozen_amount_fen != 0 OR (l.status = 'ACTIVE' AND l.available_amount_fen != 0 AND (l.type = 'PAID' OR l.expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))))) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s_member_recharge r JOIN s_venue_customer c ON c.id = r.venue_customer_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 'PENDING'))
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s_booking WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' OR (status = 'CONFIRMED' AND end_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))))
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s_user_identity_tombstone WHERE identity_hash = #{identityHash})
mapper.update: UPDATE s_user_account SET status = 'DISABLED', deleted_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), contact_name = NULL, phone = NULL, nickname = '已注销', avatar_url = NULL, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE s_employee SET user_id = NULL, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE s_post SET content_status = 'HIDDEN', updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE author_type = 'USER' AND author_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE s_post_comment SET content_status = 'HIDDEN', updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE author_user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE s_venue_review SET content_status = 'HIDDEN', updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
